summary: Former 40-foot steel tower on Owl Mountain, Jackson County, Routt NF; built 1954, taken down in the 1970s. The access road is unpaved, runs to a communication tower, and is closed by heavy snow.

facts.status_note: Taken down in the 1970s; a 4x4 guide says the road climbs to a communication tower.

access.note: Unpaved Forest Road 791 that allows hiking and highway vehicles; heavy snow closes it.

visit.trail_note: Forest Road 791 (COTREX: Owl Mountain Lookout Road, trail 791.1), total length 5.7 miles, unpaved

events.note: Register gives only 'the 1970s'; 1970 stands in for the decade

evidence.supports: 40-foot steel tower, built 1954, taken down in the 1970s
evidence.quote: This 40' steel tower was built in 1954 and taken down in the 1970s.

evidence.supports: western lookouts site marks the tower removed
association's Colorado list marks the tower removed
evidence.quote: Owl Mountain Jackson 40.46992 -106.06075 Tower Removed FFLOS US 539, CO 11

evidence.supports: forest road runs up the south side of the mountain to a communication tower
evidence.quote: Owl Mountain Lookout is an easy 4WD road that runs up the south side of Owl Mountain to a communication tower.

evidence.supports: managed by Routt National Forest, Parks Ranger District
evidence.quote: Routt National Forest, Parks Ranger District

notes_for_editor: Only the register gives construction and removal, and it gives the removal only as 'the 1970s' (stored as 1970 with a note). The 4x4 guide is undated and may be out of date on access. No staffing or fire sources were found. The access road is public forest road; the story does not say whether any part of the lookout remains at the summit, because no source says so.
